description.value:
Drunk, it tastes of nothing at all, and for a moment you can hear yourself, a step behind.

For 1 minute after you drink this potion (a bonus action), an echo of you, a silent translucent copy, appears where you stand when you drink it. Once it is gone (you stepped to it, or it was struck), a new one appears where you stand at the start of your next turn.

When you are hit by an attack and your echo is within 60 feet, you can use your reaction to trade places with it: you appear where the echo was, and the attack strikes only the fading image instead, missing you. A creature that hits the echo itself hits nothing, but the echo is destroyed, so you can't step to it until your next turn starts.

When the potion's magic ends, your last echo remains for a day, with your face and your voice, saying nothing.

Midi-QOL

Step is a reaction offered when you are hit while the potion is active. It moves you to the echo and makes that one attack miss, even a critical hit. Echoes are unlinked copies of your token, created through DAE, so harm to them never reaches you; the last one is left for the GM to remove.

activation.condition: When you are hit by an attack and your echo is within 60 feet

effects.name: Echoing Step
effects.description: An echo of you appears where you end your turn. When hit, you can use your reaction to step to it.

effects.name: Stepped Aside
effects.description: The attack that provoked the step misses.

macro.name: Draught of the Echoing Step
